scope: Owned loopback stand; synthetic member, actual upload/storage/read routes and mouse gestures. Response delays retain real server responses. No model/provider/hosted claim.
checks: Mixed CSV/text upload makes no completed companion claim while its actual response is held; completion reports the stored file after release.
Over-20-MiB companion is rejected locally; the mixed notice reports 0 of 1 stored and keeps the CSV file without a false folder success.
A completed real mouse drop copies exactly one immutable file; success claims only the copy, never automatic Ask/app context inclusion.
Double-clicking the successfully copied file opens its original cells after drag; drag itself never opens a viewer.
A real drag cancelled through the browser blur handler after a recent folder click performs no copy; the old pointer release is not reused.
Removing the icon while the actual source-content response is held prevents the copy upload and reports removal honestly.
Removing the icon after a real server copy but before response delivery preserves exactly one copied file and reports the removed icon.
A second real drop during the first content read is refused visibly; the original copy completes once with no duplicate upload.
limitations: Synthetic local member, not hosted provider authentication.
Cancellation uses a real mouse drag and an explicit browser blur-handler signal.
No model/Ask/app generation or source registration calls in this browser campaign.
Interrupted/failed harness attempts retained privately; final response delays occur inside Chrome, preserving original browser request metadata.
